title: Intelligent Applications Based on Medical Large Models to Enhance People's Healthcare Experience and Health Status
summary: Ant reports that its medical AI served 13 million users and improved annotation efficiency by 50%; individual health outcomes are not specified.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Alipay describes medical assistants for residents, clinicians, and underserved areas. The submission reports 13 million users, 78 million service interactions, and a 50% improvement in the annotation workflow developed with medical specialists. These are service and operational claims. Improved health and a more equitable distribution of care remain broader intended benefits.
purpose: Provide medical guidance and reduce administrative and information-processing work.
system: Ant medical large model and health-assistant agents
deployer: Zhejiang Provincial Health Commission; Hangzhou Municipal Medical Insurance Bureau; Renji Hospital

ratings.reason: The Ant/Renji development workflow reportedly improved annotation efficiency by 50%; this supports time savings, not a clinical outcome.
The source reports broad uptake and 98% satisfaction, but does not quantify a change in health or individual service experience.
Healthcare equity and rural access are asserted aims without a measured distributional outcome.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: Intelligent Applications Based on Medical Large Models to Enhance People's Healthcare Experience and Health Status

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Ant health assistants reach patients and support medical work

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
